snippet.title: NES - Aigiina no Yogen - From The Legend of Balubalouk (1986)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Aigina no Yogen: Balubalouk no Densetsu Yori is an Action game, developed and published by Vic Tokai, which was released in Japan in 1986.
